sources.title: Ley Federal de Juegos y Sorteos (texto vigente, PDF)
sources.publisher: Cámara de Diputados del H. Congreso de la Unión
sources.used_for: Art. 1 (gambling and betting games prohibited nationwide unless permitted under the law), Art. 2 (only listed games permitted), Art. 3 (SEGOB regulates bets), Art. 4 (SEGOB permit required for any place where betting games are run), Art. 8 (closure of unauthorized premises), Art. 12 (penalties).

sources.title: Ley Federal de Juegos y Sorteos - ficha
sources.used_for: Publication date DOF 31-12-1947. The ficha lists 'Decretos de Reforma: Sin reforma' (no amending decrees listed) - see flag F-10.

sources.title: Secretaría de Gobernación (SEGOB) - home
sources.used_for: Confirms SEGOB as the federal agency. The SEGOB games-and-raffles (Juegos y Sorteos) page was not reachable: gob.mx/segob/acciones-y-programas/juegos-y-sorteos returned 404 and juegosysorteos.gob.mx could not be fetched.

sources.title: ESPN - NFL memo on prohibited prop bets (13 Nov 2025)
sources.used_for: Reports the NFL memo's prohibited prop categories (inherently objectionable, officiating-related, determinable by one person in one play, pre-determined). The memo itself was not retrieved - see flag F-11.

sources.title: ESPN - NFL says gambling policy covers prediction markets (25 Aug 2025)
sources.used_for: Reports NFL VP & Chief Compliance Officer statement that league personnel are prohibited from prediction-market football propositions. Secondary report of a statement; not a primary policy document.

sources.title: Philadelphia Inquirer - NFL gambling guidelines (6 Jun 2023)
sources.used_for: Quotes the NFL policy sentence: 'All NFL personnel are prohibited from placing, soliciting, or facilitating any bet... on any NFL game, practice or other event.' Also quotes the 'other than players' exclusion. Secondary quote - see flag F-11.

sources.title: MLive - What is the NFL's policy on sports betting? (21 Apr 2023)
sources.used_for: Quotes policy language about players betting on other sports and the $250 fantasy-prize limit. Secondary - see flag F-11.

sources.title: sports24 - NFL injury report rules explained (Sep 2026)
sources.used_for: Definitions of Out / Doubtful / Questionable and the Wed-Fri practice-report schedule. Secondary, cites an NFL 2017 Personnel (Injury) Report Policy that was NOT retrieved - see flag F-12.

sources.title: Betting Punter - NFL inactives (2023)
sources.used_for: Claims: 46 active players per game; inactive list due 90 minutes before kickoff. Secondary - see flag F-12.

sources.title: GamblingMaps - Mexico online betting laws (5 Aug 2026)
sources.used_for: Claims about online licensing, ~30 operators and tax rates. Contradicted by other secondary sources - NOT used for any value. See flag F-09.
